manifest.description: Drive the 7-head syringe ESP32 with calibration-aware dispense amounts.

inputs.label: ESP32 Port
inputs.description: Serial device path for the connected ESP32 syringe board.

inputs.label: Calibration File
inputs.description: Calibration file used to convert dispense amounts into syringe motor steps.

inputs.label: Dispense Speed
inputs.description: Shared fallback speed used when dedicated intake and outtake speeds are not set.

inputs.label: Head A
inputs.description: Requested dispense amount for syringe head A.

inputs.label: Head B
inputs.description: Requested dispense amount for syringe head B.

inputs.label: Head C
inputs.description: Requested dispense amount for syringe head C.

inputs.label: Head D
inputs.description: Requested dispense amount for syringe head D.

inputs.label: Head E
inputs.description: Requested dispense amount for syringe head E.

inputs.label: Head F
inputs.description: Requested dispense amount for syringe head F.

inputs.label: Head G
inputs.description: Requested dispense amount for syringe head G.

advanced_inputs.label: Intake Speed
advanced_inputs.description: Overrides the shared dispense speed for the first part of the move.

advanced_inputs.label: Outtake Speed
advanced_inputs.description: Overrides the shared dispense speed for the return move in the opposite direction.

advanced_inputs.label: Head A Step Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO step pin for syringe head A when saving a reusable hardware preset.

advanced_inputs.label: Head A Dir Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO direction pin for syringe head A when saving a reusable hardware preset.

advanced_builder_inputs.description: Motor steps per full revolution used in the firmware.

advanced_builder_inputs.description: Default RPM used when no speed override is sent from the workflow.

advanced_builder_inputs.label: Microsteps
advanced_builder_inputs.description: Default microstep configuration passed to the driver timing calculations.

advanced_builder_inputs.label: Step Pulse Width (us)
advanced_builder_inputs.description: Width of each HIGH pulse sent to the step pin.

advanced_builder_inputs.label: Settle Delay (ms)
advanced_builder_inputs.description: Delay between the forward and return syringe moves.

advanced_builder_inputs.description: Default forward speed stored in firmware presets.
